Springwood Landscaping & Garden Care

Landscaping for Springwood’s leafy, bush-backed blocks — from full garden builds to ongoing maintenance and fire-season clean-ups. 20% off this spring and summer.

Springwood is the hub of the mid Mountains, lower and a good deal milder than Katoomba, and its established, leafy streets are part of what people love about living here. Many blocks are larger and gentler than up top, but they back onto bushland — gullies like Sassafras and the reserves around Magdala Creek are never far away — and that shapes how we approach a garden here.

With so many bush-backed homes, a lot of our Springwood work is ongoing rather than one-off: regular garden maintenance, hedge and shrub trimming, lawn care, tree and canopy management, and keeping gutters and yards clear as fire season approaches. Mature eucalypts drop a lot of leaf and limb, so staying on top of it matters both for looks and for safety.

We also do plenty of full builds around Springwood — reworking tired established gardens, adding paving and entertaining areas, laying new turf and building the odd retaining wall where blocks do fall away. Because the soil and light here are kinder than the upper Mountains, there’s more room to plant generously, and we make the most of it with layered, low-fuss gardens that suit family homes.

Springwood gardens

What makes Springwood different

  • Milder mid-Mountains climate. Lower and warmer than Katoomba, so a broader plant palette works and lawns establish more easily.
  • Established, leafy blocks. Bigger gardens with mature trees mean regular maintenance, pruning and canopy work are a big part of the job.
  • Bush interface. Homes backing onto gullies and reserves need fire-smart, well-kept gardens and reliable gutter and yard clearing.
  • A hub for the mid Mountains. Springwood anchors the surrounding suburbs, so we’re working across the area most weeks.
Good to know

Springwood questions, answered

Do you do regular garden maintenance in Springwood?

Yes — ongoing maintenance is one of our most-requested services here. Lawns, hedges, garden beds, pruning and general tidy-ups on a schedule that suits you, so your garden stays sharp without you lifting a finger.

Can you clear gutters and yards before fire season?

We do. For bush-backed Springwood homes we clear gutters, cut back overhanging growth and remove yard fuel loads so your place is tidier and better prepared heading into the warmer months.

My established garden needs a refresh — can you help?

Definitely. We regularly rework older Springwood gardens — new planting, paving, turf and features — keeping the mature trees you love while bringing the rest up to date.
